removalCondition: Remove after full implementation and qualification. The gate automatically returns to the strict policy at expiresAt; any extension requires new explicit maintainer approval.
activation: Repository-owned gate gathers trusted Actions/live GitHub PR context and complete revision-bracketed Sonar evidence. No caller-provided snapshot activates this policy.

compatibilityRationale: Ordered async operations and explicit portable/native implementations can create maintainability-only findings and measured duplication. Keep maintainability A and a bounded 6% duplication ceiling while preserving every correctness, reliability, security and hotspot requirement. This does not waive full implementation, validation or final maintainer review.
